4715.html:
4715 cálati 'goes away' MBh. 2. 'shakes, trembles' MBh. [~ cárati¹. — √cal]

'to open', weg. čal- 'to move'; K. ċalun 'to move, run away', rām. calṇu 'to go, walk'; P. calṇā 'to go bad, decay'; WPah. bhad. bhal. ċalnū 'to flow', cam. calṇā 'to go'; Ku. calṇo 'to move, go'; N. calnu 'to move, walk, be used' (whence caluwā 'restless'), A. saliba, B. calā; Or. caḷibā 'to move, go on, pass'; H. calnā 'to move, go on or away, be in use' (→ Mth. calab 'to go, hasten', Bhoj. calal 'to go', OAw. calaï 'starts off, goes'); OMarw. calaï 'goes'; G. caḷvũ 'to move away from'; M. ċaḷṇẽ 'to slip aside, err'.
    2. Pa. calati 'trembles', Pk. calaï; G. caḷvũ intr. 'to shake'.
    Addenda: cálati: Garh. caḷnu 'to walk'.
